post.description: Sends a call recording for AI analysis. Send a signed url for the recording along with the call type and the agent name. Credits are charged on the length of the recording, measured by us, at one credit per minute rounded up. The analysis runs in the background, so this returns a requestId which you use to check the progress and fetch the result.

requestBody.description: Details of the call to be analysed

200.description: If the auth token is valid.

value.message: Your API Key is inactive as the AI Call Analysis credits are exhausted

get.description:
Returns the finished analysis of the call. This includes the call score, a summary of the
conversation, how positive each speaker sounded, how the talking time was split, the
compliance checks that were configured, and the keywords detected. The score and the
analysis are filled in only once the status reads `0`.

| Status | Meaning | What it tells you |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-1` | PAUSED | Stopped for want of credits |
| `0` | COMPLETED | The score and analysis are ready |
| `1` | FAILED | Could not be processed, credits returned |
| `2` | IN_PROGRESS | Accepted and queued |
| `3` | TRANSCRIBED | The conversation has been written out |
| `4` | ANALYSING | The transcript is being scored |
| `5` | NO_CONVERSATION | The recording held no conversation |

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id returned when the call analysis was initiated

200.description: If the auth token is valid.

recordingUrl.description: A signed url for the recording, time limited, for example a pre-signed Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage url. It must be an https url carrying a signature, and it needs to stay valid until the analysis finishes.

callType.description: Whether the call was incoming or outgoing. Missed calls and calls of no length cannot be analysed.

callerName.description: Name of the agent who handled the call. Optional (pass it for better results).

customerName.description: Name of the customer on the call. Optional.

processId.description: Id of the process. Optional, and accepted for compatibility, but a recording sent through this API is always analysed against your default process.

metadata.description: Any reference of your own, such as a ticket number or a campaign name. Saved exactly as you send it and returned unchanged when you fetch the analysis. Up to 50 entries.

initiateCallAnalysis.description: Schema to initiate a call analysis

statusCode.description: Will be 0 in case of success

message.description: Contains the success message or error reason, based on the statusCode

requestId.description: The id we create for this analysis. Use it to check the progress and fetch the result.

status.description: Stage of the analysis when the request was accepted

creditsUsed.description: Credits charged for this request. One minute of recording costs one credit, rounded up, so a one minute call costs one credit and a call of one minute and ten seconds costs two.

initiateCallAnalysisSuccess.description: Schema for an initiated call analysis

statusCode.description: Will be 0 in case of success

message.description: Contains the success message or error reason, based on the statusCode

status.description: Stage of the analysis. See the table above.

score.description: Score out of 100 for how the call was handled, based on your scoring settings. Null until the status reads COMPLETED, and null as well when call scoring is turned off for your account, in which case the rest of the analysis is still returned.

metadata.description: The reference you sent when initiating the analysis, returned unchanged

analysis.description: The analysis of the conversation. Null until the status reads COMPLETED.

summary.description: A short summary of what the call was about

transcript.description: The conversation as it was spoken, in order. Each entry is one turn by one speaker.

speaker.description: Who was speaking on this turn, the agent or the customer

utterance.description: What was said on this turn

sentiment.description: How positive each speaker sounded, from -1 for negative to 1 for positive

wordsSpoken.description: Number of words spoken by each speaker

loudness.description: Average loudness of each speaker in decibels, and of anything that was not speech

speakingTime.description: How the call time was split, in seconds, including time spent on hold, in noise and in silence

customerSatisfaction.description: How satisfied the customer sounded by the end of the call

complianceChecks.description: Each compliance check configured for your process, and whether the agent met it on this call

entities.description: Words and phrases of interest that came up, and how often

fillerWords.description: Filler words the agent used, and how often

intentSources.description: What the customer showed interest in during the call
